property_summary: For any caller who locks in a guess at block N, settle() must still revert when invoked at block N+1 (the target block is N+1, and settle requires block.number > target), a rule the mutant breaks because it stores N, letting settle succeed already at block N+1.
change_summary: Set the target block to block.number instead of block.number + 1, changing the stored block value.
